actman_paths

Source: R/paths.R
actman_paths.Rd

Builds a small structure holding every path ACTman needs, computed once (and normalized to an absolute path) from the user-supplied working directory. This replaces the previous pattern of repeated setwd() calls scattered across the package, which left the R session's working directory mutated after any error partway through a run, and made every downstream list.files()/read.csv() call implicitly depend on "wherever the process happens to be right now" rather than an explicit path. No function in this package changes the process's working directory any more; every read/write goes through an actman_paths object instead.

Usage

actman_paths(workdir, sleepdatadir = workdir)

Arguments

workdir

The main data directory. May be given as a relative or absolute path; it is normalized to an absolute path (and must exist).

sleepdatadir

Optional separate directory for sleep-analysis inputs/outputs. Defaults to workdir. Normalized to an absolute path if it exists; left as given (with a warning suppressed) if it doesn't yet exist, since some workflows create it after the fact.

Value

A list (S3 class actman_paths) with elements workdir, sleepdatadir, managed_dir ("Managed Datasets" under workdir), results_dir ("Results" under workdir), and actogram_dir ("Actograms" under workdir).
